newsitem.title: USA: Airport Systems gets $1.2 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Airport Systems gets $1.2 mln contract.

text.p: Airport Systems International Inc said Tuesday it was awarded an approximately $1.2 million contract by the Federal Aviation Administration for the delivery of 38 distance measuring equipment (DME) systems.
The contract calls for the installation of these navigational aids to upgrade the ground-based navigational systems at various airports within the United States.
The contract also includes options for 20 additional DMEs valued at approximately $1 million.
The company said it expects to start deliveries under this contract during its fourth fiscal quarter which starts next month.
Airport Systems designs, manufactures, markets and installs ground-based equipment and airfield signs.
